ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the graph of “changes in surface water temperature along a certain latitude line in the Pacific Ocean.” <image1> Under this influence, toward which latitudinal direction do the sea-surface isotherms in sea area b in the figure bulge?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the vertical axis is surface water temperature, with the unit ℃, and the values are roughly from 10℃ to 30℃; the horizontal axis is longitude, going eastward from near 120°E through 150°E, 180°, 150°W to 120°W. There are two water-temperature variation curves in the figure: the dashed line is labeled August, and the solid line is labeled February. Sea area b is located near the western part of the longitude axis, and the curve temperature there is higher than that of the east-west adjacent sea areas at the same latitude, showing a warm-water anomaly area. Reasoning: On the same latitude line, the water temperature at b is higher than in nearby sea areas, indicating that sea area b is affected by a warm current. According to geographical principles, the water temperature in a sea area through which a warm current passes is higher than that in the sea areas on both sides at the same latitude, so the sea-surface isotherms will bulge toward the colder high-latitude direction.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的坐标和曲线，定位b海域在经度轴上的位置；比较b处水温与同纬线相邻海域水温，判断b为暖水异常区，因此受暖流影响。再根据地理规律：暖流经过处水温高于同纬度附近海区，海平面等温线向高纬方向凸出。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中纵轴为表层水温，单位为℃，数值大致从10℃到30℃；横轴为经度，从120°E附近向东经过150°E、180°、150°W到120°W。图中有两条水温变化曲线，虚线标注为8月，实线标注为2月。b海域位于经度轴上偏西的海域附近，该处曲线水温相对于同纬线东西相邻海域偏高，表现为暖水异常区。
推理：同一纬线上，b处水温高于附近海区，说明b海域受暖流影响。根据地理规律，暖流经过的海域水温高于同纬度两侧海区，因此海平面等温线会向较冷的高纬方向凸出。

method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中纵轴为温度（℃），横轴为经度，显示沿太平洋某一纬线从约120°E、150°E、180°到150°W、120°W的表层水温变化；图中有8月和2月两条水温曲线。按图中经度位置，b海域对应太平洋西部或西北太平洋一带。再推理：该位置属于暖流影响区，如黑潮及其延伸暖流影响范围。暖流把较低纬度的暖水带向较高纬度，使同一温度值在该海域相对向高纬方向伸展，因此海平面等温线会向高纬方向凸出。

raw_record.original_question:
读“沿太平洋某一纬线表层温度水温的变化”图。

<image1>

受该影响，图中b海域的海平面等温线向哪个纬度方向凸出？

There are two water-temperature variation curves in the figure: the dashed line is labeled August, and the solid line is labeled February. Sea area b is located near the western part of the longitude axis, and the curve temperature there is higher than that of the east-west adjacent sea areas at the same latitude, showing a warm-water anomaly area.
Reasoning: On the same latitude line, the water temperature at b is higher than in nearby sea areas, indicating that sea area b is affected by a warm current. According to geographical principles, the water temperature in a sea area through which a warm current passes is higher than that in the sea areas on both sides at the same latitude, so the sea-surface isotherms will bulge toward the colder high-latitude direction.
